question.prompt: Using point \(P(1,1)\) as the center of homothety, enlarge point \(A(3,2)\) by a factor of \(3\). The corresponding point \(A'\) and \(A\) are on the same side of the center of homothety. Find the coordinates of \(A'\). Enter the horizontal coordinate first, followed by the vertical coordinate, separated by a comma.

solutions.explanation: First translate so that \(P\) is the origin: the coordinates of \(A\) relative to \(P\) are \((2,1)\). Enlarging by a factor of \(3\) gives \((6,3)\). Then add the coordinates of \(P\) to obtain \((7,4)\).
solutions.title: Translate, enlarge, and translate back
